title: LMA meeting export, schema version 1
description: One structured record of a meeting: who was there and whether they consented, what was said, typed and shown, what was prepared and covered, the summary, and the action items. Within schema version 1 a field's name and meaning never change; a new field is optional, and a consumer must ignore any field it does not know. See docs/meeting-export.md.

format.description: Names the document as an LMA meeting export, so a file can be recognised by its content alone. LMA writes it first in every export. Optional in this schema, so a document validates with or without it.

participants.description: Every speaker of the transcript and every sender in the meeting chat. Absent when the transcript was deleted, or when neither transcript nor chat was included.

transcript.description: Absent when the transcript was deleted under the Retention settings (meeting.transcriptRetained is false).

whiteboards.description: The meeting's whiteboards as they are now, in the order they were made; earlier versions are not included. Empty when the transcript was deleted under the Retention settings, as whiteboards are deleted with it. Absent from exports made by a version of LMA without whiteboards.

platform.description: Zoom, Teams, Chime, Webex or Google Meet for a meeting a Virtual Participant joined; otherwise null.

captureSource.description: VIRTUAL_PARTICIPANT, STREAM_AUDIO, BROWSER_EXTENSION, DESKTOP_APP, UPLOAD or API.

endTime.description: Approximate: when an ended meeting last changed. Null while it runs.

summaryProfile.description: The meeting's summary profile; default when it has none.

name.description: A person's name, or null when it is not known. Never guessed.

consent.description: The speaker's latest consent or objection among the consent events linked to this speaker; unknown when none is, or when the same participant replied otherwise afterwards in a reply not linked to this speaker. A consent event is never matched to a speaker by name.
The meeting's consent record in LMA's own values, the same shape as the MCP get_meeting_consent tool's answer. The evidence images are never included.

rule.description: The rule of an opt-in meeting; null otherwise, as only opt-in uses one.

captureAllowed.description: Whether the meeting may be captured, as the consent record says; null when its consent was never started.

notices.description: Each posting of the notice kept on the record.

events.description: One entry per consent event, in the order recorded.

source.description: Where the reply was read: chat, voice, ui (entered by a signed-in user), attestation, or pre_meeting (a consent given in advance, counted for an attendee matched to the participant list, or the objection recorded when it was withdrawn during the meeting).

at.description: When the reply or attestation happened, or when it was recorded if the record holds only that.

speakerId.description: The speakerId of the participant the event is linked to, while the transcript still confirms the link (the linked line, or lines carrying the sender's platform participant id, under that speaker); null otherwise. A name is never matched to a speaker.

speakerLinkBasis.description: How the event was linked to the transcript speaker who gave it, when it was recorded: same_segment, the reply is that speaker's own line of the transcript; platform_identity, a chat reply whose sender the meeting platform gave the same participant id as that speaker's lines (the id itself is not exported). Null for an event that was never linked.

speakerLinkedAt.description: When the event was linked to its speaker; null for an event that was never linked.

matchBasis.description: For a pre_meeting event, how the attendee was matched to the meeting's participant list: display_name, their display name in the meeting was that of one listed person. Null for every other event.

noticeHash.description: The SHA-256, in hex, of the text the person agreed to.

withdrawn.description: True on the objection recorded when the consent was withdrawn during the meeting.

givenInAdvance.description: For a pre_meeting event, the consent given in advance it counted: its scope, when it was given, until when it counts, and the hash and version of its text. Never the person's address. Null for every other event.

hasEvidence.description: Whether evidence images exist; they are not included.

startTime.description: Seconds on the meeting's timeline: the time stored with the evidence, else its segment's start.

endTime.description: The end of the segment the evidence names; null when it names none, or the segment is not in the transcript (for example once the transcript was deleted).

quote.description: Null once the transcript was deleted.

speakerId.description: A participant's speakerId; null for screen text.

channel.description: REMOTE, LOCAL or MEETING_CHAT; null for screen text.

sharedBy.description: The speakerId of the chat sender who shared it first.

profile.description: The summary profile that wrote the stored summary; default for the default.

source.description: generated, or manual when somebody edited it.

owner.description: A name as said in the meeting; null when nobody was named.

startTime.description: Seconds on the meeting's timeline: the time stored with the item, else its segment's start.

endTime.description: The end of the segment the item names; null when it names none, or the segment is not in the transcript.

instructions.description: What the assistant was asked to keep on it.

kind.description: markdown, or a diagram in a subset of Mermaid.

source.description: user: a person wrote or changed it; assistant: the assistant keeps it.
